key_insight: Autonomous deep-research AI agents can systematically scout, translate, and evaluate drug assets disclosed in regional, non-English channels, enabling scalable global deal discovery that humans alone miss.
problem_solved: Addresses the gap in scouting and evaluating drug candidates that are disclosed outside major English-language channels—data is fragmented, multilingual, and too large for manual triage, causing missed investment and BD opportunities.
method: Multilingual data ingestion pipeline: scrape patents, regional publications, clinical registries and company disclosures across languages and formats.
Autonomous AI agents: iterative retrieval + domain-tuned LLM reasoning to extract, normalize, and summarize candidate assets with provenance.
Prioritization & evaluation: automated scoring against investor/BD criteria (mechanism, stage, IP strength), with human-in-the-loop validation for high-confidence leads.
impact: Makes global drug-asset scouting scalable and actionable for AI/ML teams in investing and BD, reducing language and scale barriers and improving the quality and timeliness of deal flow.
visual_elements: World map heatmap showing concentration of non-U.S. disclosures and discovered assets
Pipeline diagram: ingestion → agent analysis → scoring → human validation
Before/after bar chart: manual vs agent-discovered assets (coverage, speed)
Icon set: patents, papers, clinical trials, language/translation to convey multilingual sources
paper_title: Hunt Globally: Deep Research AI Agents for Drug Asset Scouting in Investing, Business Development, and Search & Evaluation
paper_authors: Alisa Vinogradova, Vlad Vinogradov, Luba Greenwood, Ilya Yasny, Dmitry Kobyzev
